changeability.rational: Most behavioral fixes land in one obvious place (format.ts, spriteUrl, cardsForPokemonRefs), but the two parallel card builders and the six caching sites are the duplicated-logic failure mode: a sprite or caching change must be applied N times.

coupling.rationale: Layering is exemplary for this size: routes → server fns → VM builders → api client → format helpers, with a sharp client/server seam and URL-as-state. Minor deductions: components type-import from the server-only-marked data.ts, and not-found wiring exists in two places (router.tsx:8-10 and __root.tsx:19).

evidence: app/src/lib/data.ts:97 — cardsForPokemonRefs absorbs the real variation across move/ability/type Pokémon lists (dedupe, alternate-form exclusion, dex ordering) via one optional hiddenById param instead of flag creep
app/src/lib/components.tsx:54 — CardList/PokemonCard with a single showTypes flag serves home and all reference lists, so a new sort or badge could be added in one component
app/src/lib/MovesTable.tsx:34-52 — generic column sort (missing-values-last, aria-sort) works for any MoveTableVM without new flags
app/src/lib/data.ts:137-174 — buildHomeData re-derives dex/humanName/sprite into a separate CatalogEntry type instead of reusing CardVM; the two shapes drift together
app/src/lib/data.ts:20-71 — the memoize pattern is copy-pasted five times rather than factored into a helper
abstraction_design.rationale: The abstractions track the app's genuine variation well (refs→cards, Section, TypeBadge, MovesTable), which is why adding an Items section or a card sort is cheap. The one miss is the home page's parallel card type and the repeated memoization boilerplate — classic copy-paste, not flag creep.

findings.issue: buildHomeData duplicates card construction (dex, humanName, sprite, types) into a parallel CatalogEntry type instead of reusing the CardVM built for every other list; card-semantics fixes (sprite resolution, ordering) must be made in two builders
findings.suggestion: Have buildHomeData produce CardVM-based entries (or a shared speciesToCard helper taking id+name) so all card lists share one construction path

findings.issue: Caching is split across apiGet's promise cache (api.ts:17) and five copy-pasted module-level memoization blocks (data.ts:20,33,45,56,67); a caching-rule change (TTL, invalidation) touches six sites
findings.suggestion: Add a small memoize(fn) helper in api.ts and route all shared-resource caching through it

findings.issue: The shared PokemonCard embeds ability-specific knowledge (`Hidden ability` label keyed on card.hidden), so removing the Abilities feature leaves dead code in a shared component
findings.suggestion: Take the hidden badge as children/render-prop or move the label into the ability route

findings.issue: The entire data layer is untyped (`any` for API records and lists), so edits inside builders get no compiler help despite the good VM boundary
findings.suggestion: Define minimal interfaces for the API slices actually consumed (species, pokemon, type, move, ability) in a types module

findings.issue: NotFoundPage renders an inline <title>, duplicating the route `head` meta mechanism used everywhere else (routes set title via `head: ...meta`)
findings.suggestion: Provide the not-found title via the root route's `head`/`notFoundComponent` head handling and drop the inline <title>

findings.issue: Not-found wiring is registered twice: root `notFoundComponent` (__root.tsx:19) and router `defaultNotFoundComponent`
findings.suggestion: Keep one registration (the root route's) to avoid divergence

findings.issue: Client components type-import from data.ts, a file headed 'Server-only data layer'; a careless value import would pull server code into the client bundle
findings.suggestion: Move VM interfaces (CardVM, MoveTableVM, etc.) into a `types.ts` imported by both sides

findings.issue: `data.catalog as CatalogEntry[]` cast suggests the server fn's return type isn't flowing to useLoaderData
findings.suggestion: Type the server fn handler's return (or wrap with a typed function) so the cast disappears

summary: A clean, current-idiom TanStack Start app: routes consume typed view models through validated server fns, all shared formatting is single-sourced in format.ts, and every Pokémon card list flows through one CardList/spriteUrl path, which makes most extensions and fixes one-touch. The editability weaknesses are duplication rather than tangles: the home page rebuilds cards in a parallel CatalogEntry type, caching logic is copy-pasted across six sites, and ability-specific knowledge leaks into the shared card component. Net: easy to extend, slightly annoying to change card or caching semantics.

scenarios.change: Remove the Abilities pages and every link to them
scenarios.notes: No nav links or cross-references beyond the Pokémon page's Abilities section, so every edit is findable; but the feature is spread over six files, and the hidden flag in components.tsx and .card-hidden CSS are easy to leave behind.

scenarios.change: Fix card sprites for species whose default Pokémon has a different name (e.g. Deoxys)
scenarios.notes: If the fix stays at the URL-pattern level it's one function (api.ts spriteUrl) and covers every list, since both card builders call it. If it requires resolving the default Pokémon's actual sprite record, it must be made in both cardsForPokemonRefs (data.ts:116) and buildHomeData (data.ts:174) — and the home builder never fetches Pokémon records, so the fix there is structural.

scenarios.change: Add sorting by name to every list of Pokémon cards
scenarios.notes: All four lists (home, move, ability, type) render through CardList (components.tsx:54); adding a sort there — or a shared sort helper on CardVM — is a single trivially safe change. Only caveat: server-side dex ordering would be bypassed, so decide the layer consciously.

scenarios.change: Add an Items section (/items, /items/:name) shaped like Moves
scenarios.notes: Section, TypeBadge, the dl fact-list and the route/head/loader pattern are all reusable as-is; but there is no generic 'detail page' abstraction — buildItemsPageData, getItemsPageData and the route file are written fresh following the Moves template. Roughly 3 short files of scaffold, consistent with the framework's own idiom.

scenarios.change: Change the API base URL and caching rules
scenarios.notes: Base URL is genuinely one place (api.ts:4, shared by apiGet and spriteUrl). Caching rules are not: the per-request promise cache in apiGet (api.ts:17) plus five memoization blocks in data.ts:20-71 each encode 'cache forever, drop on failure'; adding a TTL or invalidation means editing all six.
